# Anne Shirley & Josephine Barry

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) — prime favorite · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P94](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0094), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. ## Shared scenes

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at Diana's house, accidentally leaping onto visiting [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who reacts furiously.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P27](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P58](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0058)_

> After discussing her latest blunder with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her bed. Her honest confession and imaginative explanations charm Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) into staying in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continuing Diana's music lessons.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P66](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0066), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P79](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0079), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087)_

> During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), making [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realize how deeply she loves the girl. During her seven weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives many visitors and eagerly anticipates returning to school under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. > [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After getting permission, the girls spend a delightful week attending the fair, visiting the park, and seeing a concert before returning home.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P27](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0027)_

> [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) bids farewell to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), reflecting fondly on how Anne's presence brought life into her home. The girls enjoy a scenic drive back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a warm welcome and a special dinner from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settles into student life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), forming new friendships with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while keeping up her academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She spends visits with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and keeps her exams in perspective as commencement approaches.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P15](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0015)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns she has won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal. After graduating, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where she notices Matthew's failing health and learns about potential financial trouble with the Abbey Bank. [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) lovingly tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) he is prouder of her than he would be of a dozen boys.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream
